_comment: Windows' OWN presentation policy for the modern (Windows 11) context menu.
Contains only Windows canonical verb names / CommandStore names / string resource refs.
It never lists third-party entries: those are discovered at runtime on each machine
(classic IContextMenu verbs, packaged IExplorerCommand extensions, CommandStore handlers,
the user's Settings > Personalization > Context menu preferences).
Windows does not expose this policy through any API; values were observed with
tools/menu-probe.ps1 and must be re-verified on other builds (REPORT.md).
Classic verbs NOT promoted here remain reachable via 'Show more options' / the classic menu.

profiles.name: win11-26h2
profiles._itemPromotedVerbs: Shown in THIS order (Windows' order, not the classic menu's). 'print' is not promoted (verified: png, xlsx, docx, txt).
profiles._alwaysSubmenuVerbs: Windows' modern menu always shows 'Open with' as a submenu (verified: xlsx/docx, where the classic item is 'Open with...'). An item's 'New' verb (Office documents) is shown as Windows' New-item (ShellNew) submenu of the containing folder (verified: desktop .docx, its New submenu lists Folder, Shortcut, Word Document, ...).
profiles._honorLegacyDisable: Static verbs with LegacyDisable are not shown; if that removes the classic default verb, the next static verb of the same ProgID is shown first, followed by a separator (verified on .url only; UNVERIFIED as a general rule).
profiles._backgroundRowVerbs: A folder background's menu shows Paste as a button in the row above the list, not in the list (File Explorer, 26300; user's capture 2026-11-19).
profiles._extendedOnlyVerbs: Background entries listed only when the menu is opened with Shift held (Explorer's list has no Paste shortcut).
profiles._appExtensionsFooter: Last entry of the App extensions submenu (verified: desktop background, .docx, .png). Opens the same Settings page as Customize menu (UNVERIFIED).

desktopOwnEntries._comment: Entries Explorer's desktop VIEW adds to the background menu (not the folder's IContextMenu). In Deskboxes the core implements them; the host only takes Windows' localized text from DefView's own menu resource. Positions verified on 26300.9974.

iconAssets._comment: Explorer's own menu icons: installed SVGs named by command id, looked up at runtime under <package>/<path>/contrast-standard/theme-dark|theme-light (contrast-black|contrast-white in high contrast). Lookup: names[id], then id, then 'windows.'+id (case-insensitive). The names below are the ids whose file name differs; verified by comparing captures (tools/menu-view-check.ps1).
